note: Seeded from Teach Yourself CS (teachyourselfcs.com, recalled from memory; verify) plus extra areas. Edit freely.

areas.name: Programming paradigms
areas.probe: functional programming, interpreters, SICP-style ideas

areas.name: Computer architecture
areas.probe: CPU, memory hierarchy, assembly, building an emulator

areas.name: Algorithms and data structures
areas.probe: implementing trees, graphs, heaps, tries; complexity analysis

areas.name: Math for CS
areas.probe: discrete maths, probability, linear algebra applied in code

areas.name: Operating systems
areas.probe: processes, threads, scheduling, filesystems, syscalls

areas.name: Networking
areas.probe: raw sockets, TCP/UDP, writing a protocol or HTTP server from scratch

areas.name: Database internals
areas.probe: storage engines, indexes, B-trees, query planning, transactions

areas.name: Languages and compilers
areas.probe: lexers, parsers, ASTs, bytecode VMs, type checkers

areas.name: Distributed systems
areas.probe: consensus, replication, queues, eventual consistency

areas.name: Concurrency and parallelism
areas.probe: async runtimes, lock-free ideas, actors, data races

areas.name: AI agents and LLM workflows
areas.probe: tool use, MCP, agent loops, evals, RAG

areas.name: Machine learning and data science
areas.probe: Python, numpy/pandas, training or evaluating a model

areas.name: Embedded and hardware
areas.probe: microcontrollers, GPIO, I2C/SPI, firmware, real-time constraints

areas.name: Signal processing and audio
areas.probe: FFT, filters, synthesis, DSP

areas.name: Graphics and game engines
areas.probe: rendering, shaders, ECS, physics, game loops

areas.name: Security and cryptography
areas.probe: crypto primitives, auth flows, fuzzing, reverse engineering

areas.name: Scientific computing and simulation
areas.probe: numerical methods, cheminformatics, simulations, bioinformatics

areas.name: Systems languages (Rust, Go, C)
areas.probe: manual memory, ownership, low-level performance

areas.name: DevOps and infrastructure
areas.probe: containers, orchestration, observability, IaC

areas.name: Performance engineering
areas.probe: profiling, benchmarking, cache effects, optimisation
